title: Public Records Management Policy
owner: Office of the Chief Information Officer
text:
4.1 Records ownership
Each department must designate a records officer responsible for managing official records throughout their lifecycle.

4.2 Retention and disposal
Official records must be retained for the period in the approved departmental records schedule. A record must not be destroyed while subject to an audit, investigation, litigation hold, or access request. Disposal must be authorised by the records officer and recorded in the disposal register.

4.3 Digital records
Digital records must preserve authenticity, integrity, and accessibility. Departments should maintain a documented backup and recovery process.

title: Circular 07/2025: Procurement Planning
text:
1. Purpose
This circular provides a sample planning procedure for departments.

3. Annual procurement plans
Each accounting officer should ensure that an annual procurement plan is prepared before the start of the financial year. The plan should identify anticipated requirements, estimated timelines, and budget alignment. Material changes should be documented and approved under the department's delegation framework.

4. Publication
Departments should publish non-sensitive procurement opportunities through their designated public channels.

title: Responsible Use of AI Framework
text:
1. Scope
This synthetic framework applies to departmental pilots that use AI to support public-sector work.

3. Transparency
Users must be informed when AI contributes to content or analysis. Outputs must be traceable to their source material and limitations must be explained.

5. Human oversight
AI may support analysis but must not make or communicate a final administrative decision on behalf of an authorised official. An accountable official must review material outputs before use.

6. Privacy
Teams should minimise personal information used in prompts, datasets, and operational logs. Personal information must be handled under applicable privacy requirements and approved departmental controls.
